name: NYC Planimetric Database: Open Space (Other)
description:
This dataset is a sample of 5,000 records from the NYC Planimetric Database covering open space features classified as "Other," meaning open spaces that fall outside the main park and recreational categories. Each row represents a single mapped open space polygon, most commonly cemeteries, with fields for a source identifier, feature and sub-feature classification codes, an optional name, a status flag, and geometry measures (area and perimeter length).

The feature and sub-feature codes divide records into three classes, with the two dominant classes split roughly evenly (about 52% and 47.5%) and a small third class under 1%. The name field is missing for about 47% of rows, and nearly all named entries that are not blank read "NO NAME"; the remaining names are specific cemeteries such as St Raymond Cemetery, Trinity Cemetery, and Holy Cross Cemetery. Status shows whether each feature is Unchanged (about 73%), New (about 21%), or Updated (about 6
